principal_added.authority: propose only: no decide or revoke role, so Governance 'decider must not be the proposer' is unchanged

sequence: POST /bff/evolution-decisions/{id}/execution-approval-request -> Evolution owner verifies the decision is a direct EvolutionDecision (not listed in any EvolutionProgram.source_decision_ids, else 409), computes subject.proposal_id and subject.proposal_content_digest, and files one Governance evolution_execute request (deterministic id apv-evoexec-<decision>-<digest16>) under the propose-only principal; on 409 from Governance, the owner reads the existing request back under its proposer principal and returns decision_state, decision, and expires_at so the BFF reuses pending/valid-approved requests and returns 409 (approval_rejected, approval_revoked, approval_expired) telling the caller to cancel the decision and propose anew when terminal/expired
operator decides once via existing POST /bff/approvals/{id}/decide

that one approved record binds ReviewMutation and ApproveEvolutionDecision (BFF preconditions: evolution_execute binds a direct decision; evolution_proposal no longer does; program approvals unchanged)

ExecuteEvolutionAction (paper candidate_artifact freeze): owner receipt-binding preflight re-runs require_execution_approval -> bound FreezeOrder recorded in Governance (reused on retry) -> /execute with execution_receipt downstream_kind=governance_freeze_order
behavior_notes: The old unbound FreezeOrder write after /execute is removed for every action type.
The FreezeOrder is a governance quarantine record only; it does not stop trading. Command result carries governance_quarantine_only=true, trading_stopped=false and a notice.
Dispatch worker main() and Evolution main share configured_adapter_registry(EVOLUTION_GOVERNANCE_BASE_URL) so both processes build GovernanceFreezeOrderAdapter identically and cannot drift.

Dispatch worker holds an approved decision only when adapter.auto_dispatch is False and unsupported_freeze_reason(payload) is None (paper candidate_artifact freeze): no submit, no failed attempt, no dead letter, no error log. Live/canary freeze, retire, and other governance actions keep the unsupported refusal + dead-letter path.

Re-requesting an approval after rejection, revocation, or expiry returns 409 from the BFF with a named reason (approval_rejected, approval_revoked, approval_expired) instructing the caller to cancel the decision and propose anew; pending and still-valid approved requests reuse the deterministic id.
A decision listed in any EvolutionProgram.source_decision_ids is refused with 409 on POST /api/evolution/proposals/{id}/execution-approval-request.
Freezes outside paper candidate_artifact scope are refused with unsupported_freeze_scope and write nothing.
No already approved decision is migrated or executed, including the chain 4923 decision; services/governance behavior is not modified.

P3: services/evolution/main.py request_execution_approval refuses decisions listed in any EvolutionProgram.source_decision_ids with 409.
e2e: services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_evolution_freeze_execute_e2e.py drives the real BFF command routes and /bff/approvals/{id}/decide with the real Evolution app (EVOLUTION_AUTH_MODE=token) and the real Governance app (strict JWT) in process, using dispatch_worker.configured_adapter_registry for _tick. The only seam is urllib.request.urlopen routing a host to the app and forwarding the exact emitted headers; any host other than evolution/governance fails the test (zero runtime, broker, capital calls). Negative cases: evolution_proposal record, pending, rejected, another tenant, changed proposal digest, Governance write failure, failure after the FreezeOrder write (retry reuses it, single cooldown), freeze outside paper artifact scope, re-request after rejected/revoked/expired (409 named reason), and program-linked decision refused with 409.
